In his recent op-ed in the @FinancialXpress, @SomitDasgupta, argues that Andhra Pradesh's move to grant Google's proposed $15-billion Visakhapatnam data centre a "deemed distribution licensee" status is ill-conceived and legally untenable. The route would let the 1 GW facility avoid open-access charges and source power far more cheaply, but the Electricity Act, 2003, makes no provision for a deemed distribution licensee that isn't a government company, which Google is not. Drawing a parallel with the railways case, where the Supreme Court ruled in May that railways is a consumer and not a deemed distribution licensee, Dasgupta warns the Google move risks the same legal fate. At Pacific Cyber Week’s Women in Cyber Networking Breakfast hosted by PaCSON, we celebrated and honoured the contributions of our amazing women who make up the ICT and cyber security industry. In particular, we commemorated Ms Georgina Kiele from PNG Department of ICT, who was committed to PNG’s cyber resilience. The inspirational women who joined me on my panel shared their experiences and commitment to uplifting women and creating inclusive spaces now and into the next generation. Tonga Attorney-General and Chair of the PILON Cybercrime Working Group Linda Folaumoetui shared her own experience of finding creative ways to network, which is respectful of local cultures. Georgina Naigulevu from Fiji reminded us to build accessibility considerations into our approaches, our technology and our Digital Public Infrastructure solutions for the future – a timely reminder of the importance of inclusivity for persons with a disability. Czech Cyber Attache to the Indo-Pacific Veronika Kolek Netolická shared her journey over her career in cyber, and her establishment of the first women in cyber network in the Czech Republic. Diane Kambanei outlined her advocacy for women’s rights in online spaces, and the PNG Government’s commitments to combatting technology-facilitated gender-based violence. Honoured to highlight the contributions and leadership by women in cyber in our Pacific.

Both sides exchanged views on ways to further advance ASEAN-Saudi Arabia cooperation, and discussed regional and international issues of mutual interest and concern.

Secretary-General of ASEAN, Dr. Kao Kim Hourn, today held a bilateral meeting with Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Netherlands, H.E. Tom Berendsen, in Manila, the Philippines, on the sidelines of the celebration of the 50th anniversary of the Treaty of Amity and Cooperation in Southeast Asia (TAC). They discussed ways to further strengthen the ASEAN-Netherlands Development Partnership and exchanged views on regional and international issues of common interests and concern.

Secretary-General of ASEAN, Dr. Kao Kim Hourn, on 24 July 2026, witnessed the ministerial-level signing ceremony of the Instruments of Accession to the Treaty of Amity and Cooperation in Southeast Asia (TAC) by the Republic of Lithuania, the Republic of Poland, Romania, the Kingdom of Sweden, the on the margins of the 59th ASEAN Foreign Ministers’ Meeting and Related Meetings, in Manila, the Philippines. The accession of these countries brings the number of High Contracting Parties to the TAC to 62. Held during the milestone year marking the 50th anniversary of the TAC, the signing ceremony underscores the Treaty’s enduring relevance and growing importance, as well as the interest that external partners place on ASEAN, and their commitment to uphold the purposes and principles enshrined in the Treaty.

মক্কার মসজিদে হারাম ও মদিনার মসজিদে নববিতে আজ (শুক্রবার, ২৪ জুলাই) জুমার নামাজের ইমামতি করবেন ও খুতবা দেবেন যারা, তারা হচ্ছেন প্রখ্যাত দুই শায়খ। মসজিদে হারাম কর্তৃপক্ষ এই তথ্য জানিয়েছে। মসজিদে হারাম আজ মসজিদে হারামে জুমার নামাজ পড়াবেন শায়খ ড. বানদার বালিলাহ। তিনি প্রায় এক দশক যাবত মসজিদে হারামের ইমাম হিসেবে কর্মরত রয়েছেন। শায়খ বালিলাহ ১৯৭৫ সালে সৌদি আরবের মক্কায় জন্মগ্রহণ করেন। তিনি মক্কার উম্মুল কুরা ইউনিভার্সিটি থেকে ইসলামি আইনে গ্রাজুয়েশন সম্পন্ন করেন এবং ইসলামি ফিকহে মাস্টার্স করেন। ২০০৮ সালে তিনি মদিনা বিশ্ববিদ্যালয় থেকে পিএইচডি ডিগ্রি অর্জন করেন। ২০১৩ সালে শায়খ বানদার বালিলাহ মসজিদে হারামের ইমাম নিযুক্ত হন। এর আগে মক্কার আরও কিছু মসজিদে তিনি ইমাম হিসেবে দায়িত্ব পালন করেছেন। মসজিদে নববি আজ মসজিদে নববিতে জুমার নামাজ পড়াবেন শায়খ কারি আব্দুল ‍মুহসিন ইবনে মুহাম্মাদ ইবনে আব্দুর রহমান আল-কাসিম। তার জন্ম সৌদি আরবের মক্কায় ১৯৬৭ সালে। মসজিদে নববির ইমাম ও খতিব হিসেবে দায়িত্ব পালনের পাশাপাশি তিনি মদিনার শরিয়া আদালতের বিচারক হিসেবেও দায়িত্ব পালন করছেন। শায়খ আল-কাসিম ইমাম মুহাম্মাদ বিন সৌদ বিশ্ববিদ্যালয় থেকে বিএ ডিগ্রি লাভ করেন, তারপর একই বিশ্ববিদ্যালয় থেকে ১৯৮৯ সালে তুলনামূলক ফিকহে মাস্টার্স করেন এবং ১৯৯২ সালে ইসলামি ফিকহে পিএইচডি ডিগ্রি অর্জন করেন। #islam #muslim #IslamicNews #somoytv

𝗪𝗼𝗺𝗲𝗻 𝗮𝗿𝗲 𝗱𝗼𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗳𝗮𝗿𝗺𝗶𝗻𝗴. 𝗕𝘂𝘁 𝘁𝗵𝗲𝘆 𝗮𝗿𝗲 𝘀𝘁𝗶𝗹𝗹 𝗻𝗼𝘁 𝗿𝗲𝗰𝗼𝗴𝗻𝗶𝘀𝗲𝗱 𝗮𝘀 𝗳𝗮𝗿𝗺𝗲𝗿𝘀. This is a critical blind spot in India's agricultural policy. In the last 8 years, rural female workforce participation has almost doubled, from 23.7% to 44.9%. 106 million women are employed in agriculture in India today, but 40.2% of them are unpaid workers. Women now account for 48% of India’s total agricultural workforce. Yet, as per the last agricultural census of 2015-16, they hold just 14% of the total operational landholdings. This gap has a name – farming the land without being formally recognized as its farmer. That matters because eligibility for major schemes like PM-KISAN is tied to documented land ownership. Women who cultivate family or community land, without a legal title in their name, have no access to the subsidies, credit, and institutional support that recognition unlocks. Maharashtra has just become the first state to legislate a fix. Under the Maharashtra Women Farmers Empowerment Act, 2026, any woman engaged in agriculture or allied activity for at least one season a year can now be recognized as a "Woman Farmer" and issued a Woman Farmer Certificate - independent of land title. The Act also mandates a dedicated digital registry to route benefits, credit, and subsidies directly to certified women. The legislation is an important institutional shift. Its success, however, will depend on effective implementation, awareness, and ensuring that women are actually enrolled and able to access the support available to them. Moreover, this is one state's response to a national challenge. Across India, the mismatch between who works the land and who's recognised as its farmer continues, and until that changes, millions of women remain excluded from the systems built to support them. Recognising women as farmers is not merely a matter of identity, it is indeed fundamental to improving agricultural productivity, ensuring efficient allocation of resources, strengthening rural livelihoods, and advancing women's economic empowerment. Maharashtra has shown one possible pathway. The question now is whether other states and eventually the national policy framework will follow.

📝 Nota à imprensa sobre a imposição de novas tarifas unilaterais dos EUA contra o Brasil O Governo brasileiro rechaça a decisão do governo dos Estados Unidos de impor tarifas de 12,5% sobre produtos brasileiros em função do resultado da investigação da Seção 301 relativa à proibição de importação relacionadas ao trabalho forçado. Na ausência de base legal interna para sustentar sua política comercial protecionista, o USTR optou por manipular tema caro aos direitos humanos e à luta dos trabalhadores e trabalhadoras em todo o mundo para acusar 59 países e a União Europeia de práticas desleais. Ao longo da investigação, o Ministério do Trabalho e Emprego prestou explicações e forneceu farta documentação sobre a legislação brasileira e da atuação das nossas autoridades aduaneiras para coibir importações de bens produzidos por trabalho forçado. Vale ressaltar, ainda, que o Brasil é reconhecido há décadas pela Organização Internacional do Trabalho (OIT) pelos fortes compromissos assumidos no combate ao trabalho forçado. Somos signatários de 66 Convenções em vigor na OIT. Enquanto os Estados Unidos, que se arrogam o direito de nos julgar e de impor sanções, ratificaram apenas 10 dessas Convenções. O Brasil ratificou todos os quatro instrumentos da OIT relacionados ao trabalho forçado: a Convenções 29 de 1930; a Convenção 105 de 1957; a Recomendação 203 e o Protocolo à Convenção 29, ambos de 2014. Os EUA só ratificaram um desses instrumentos. Os acordos de livre comércio celebrados pelo Brasil e pelo MERCOSUL, incluindo com Chile, União Europeia e Associação Europeia de Livre Comércio, contêm compromissos de eliminação do trabalho forçado e compulsório e de aplicação efetiva dessas proibições. Esse compromisso de combate ao comércio internacional de bens relacionados ao trabalho forçado é intensificado pela abordagem multidimensional de nossas políticas domésticas de fiscalização, prevenção, acolhimento pós-resgate das vítimas e combate ao trabalho escravo contemporâneo. Tipificamos como crime não apenas a submissão ao trabalho forçado, mas as jornadas exaustivas, as condições degradantes de trabalho e restrição de locomoção. Responsabilizamos as empresas e indivíduos, aplicando multas severas, e mantemos um cadastro de “Lista Suja” de empregadores. Tendo em vista o caráter completamente arbitrário e injustificado das tarifas anunciadas contra o Brasil, iniciaremos imediatamente os trâmites para acionar os instrumentos previstos na Lei de Reciprocidade, aprovada por unanimidade pelo Congresso Nacional, e levaremos o tema ao mecanismo de solução de controvérsias da OMC. The Changxin Palace Lamp, one of the greatest treasures of the Hebei Museum, is a gilded bronze oil lamp from China's Western Han Dynasty (206 BC-AD 24). Unearthed in 1968 from the tomb of Dou Wan, wife of Prince Jing of the Zhongshan state, it is celebrated for its ingenious design. Fumes produced by the burning oil are drawn through a hollow sleeve of the kneeling palace maid and collected inside her body, helping to keep the surrounding air clean. The lamp can also be taken apart for easy cleaning, while inscriptions on its surface record its changing ownership among Western Han palace households. Blending sophisticated metallurgy, refined craftsmanship, and remarkable ingenuity, the Changxin Palace Lamp stands as an enduring symbol of the technological and artistic achievements of the Han Dynasty. chinabound.cn Travel with ease in China, and with meaning. #ChangxinPalaceLamp #HebeiMuseum #ChinaBound #ASnapshotOfChina

I've praised a few malwares for various reasons. However, this particular malware is very interesting. - Initially masquerading malware, designed to target very specific audience - Written in multiple programming languages. However, the first stage is written in an uncommon programming language (Delphi) and compiled using an uncommon compiler (Embarcadero), specifically Delphi GUI TForm from Embarcadero (Vcl?) - Obfuscated, in a very natural way. The binary at first glance appears semi-legitimate, it hides itself well - The first stage (stager, or packer) contains multiple layers of decoy data. It makes reverse engineering challenging, not due to difficulty but time exhaustion - Secondary stage (where I'm currently at) is loaded into memory discretely, it flows naturally with the GUI application. When decompiled, the stager has over 15,000 functions. It makes finding the in-memory loaded secondary stage tricky - The secondary stage has some form of interprocess communication, it relies on the first stage to load it. If the first stage is not present, it does not work. - The second stage works (in a currently unknown capacity) to load a third stage payload. However, the secondary stage with the first stage work (in a currently unknown way) to decrypt the third (and potentially final) stage a/k/a the actual payload - The second stage uses deterministic probability to alert the first stage if the machine executing the first stage is a virtual machine and/or anti malware environment. - The second stage has multiple integrity checks, it ensures it has not been tampered with to force the binary to pull the third and final stage. This malware is pretty tricky. It definitely hasn't been written by a noob. This is definitely a very skilled Threat Actor who is using AI to supercharge their code base. Based on my conversations with my colleague, and information he can share, this code base has been rapidly evolving over the past couple of months in a uncharacteristic manner. While this Threat Actor has always shown evolution and improvement, it is now much faster, precise, and flexible. Overall, based on what I've seen so far, they've put in a lot of work to make this as painful as possible. In order to successfully reverse engineer this binary, it require outside the box thinking and/or building a custom solution to successfully trick the secondary stager to give up the goop (the third stage)... or a custom extractor to pull the third stage statically. No solution is ideal. This is good malware. If it's not state-sponsored, it's someone who has been doing this a long time and knows ball. I listened to 85 minutes of The Economist’s interview of Elon so you don’t have to. Besides, it’s behind a paywall. Elon’s predictions: In five years, AI compute will exceed the sum of all human intelligence. In ten years, we will have reached the age of abundance. Money won’t matter. Everyone will have what they need or want (at least in economies that embrace AI). Ms. Beddoes tried to pin Elon down on how the economy will transform that way, but he wouldn’t get into specifics beyond noting that widespread AI robotics is a deflationary force. This means governments won’t need to raise taxes for universal basic income schemes, or, as Elon likes to call it, universal high income, since they will simply be able to print money to ward off deflation caused by the robot economy. She noted that Elon appears to have a more sanguine view of AI lately. He replied that he’s concluded superintelligent AI is now inevitable, so there’s no point trying to stop or slow it down, it can’t be done. We might as well enjoy the ride. The interviewer also noted that Mars no longer seems to be Elon’s overall ambition. He answered that his real mission was always to propagate and preserve human consciousness into the far future. Mars was just a vehicle for that. But now AI is a very important part of that goal. AI will necessarily be part of any future plan. And then came the oh-so-typical, increasingly tiresome part of most long journalist interviews: the interviewer constructs a straw-man version of Elon and argues against it. Elon carefully explained that he isn’t a raging far-right extremist, racist Nazi who kills puppies … and the journalist still didn't believe it. It is so effing tiresome. The lack of self-awareness on the part of journalists is off the charts. She complained about Elon’s supposed misperception of how dangerous London is, while remaining oblivious to the role she plays in creating the giant misperception of Elon as a person in her own writing. Elon defended his political views, saying he is for secure borders, locking up criminals, and balanced government spending, something even she had to admit didn’t sound crazy. And… that’s about it for an 85-minute interview. I couldn’t help but think that the next long-form interview Elon does should be conducted by an AI.

Notes from a DeepSeek investor meeting leaked today (reported by Sina Tech). Liang Wenfeng rarely speaks in public. Three lines stand out. On open source: "We will definitely open-source, and our strongest models too. I see no inherent advantage to closed source." On why that does not hurt revenue: "We only make about 6x profit, roughly a 10-month payback. On that premise, open source has zero impact on the business model. If you wanted 100x profit, it would. A third party deploying independently could hit 20x cost, lower than yours." On culture: "We do not even work overtime, because it is just not that hard. From the outside it looks like we picked hard mode. But we gave up a lot elsewhere, so we are actually very relaxed." My read: this is the clearest statement yet of open source as pricing discipline. The 6x cap is not modesty. It is the mechanism that makes open weights costless to the business, and Liang calls the restraint itself what keeps DeepSeek durable. Most Western labs are priced, and funded, for the 100x world. If open weights plus a hard margin cap is the durable model, what does that say about labs whose valuations assume 100x?

Since the #Ebola outbreak was declared in #DRC last May, more than 500 people have recovered. But at the same time, more than 1000 people have died. Most of those deaths occurred in communities, not in Ebola treatment centres. Community engagement and ownership of the response remain central to saving lives and stopping this virus. More than 2500 cases have been reported so far. But because insecurity and active conflict continue to limit access to affected areas, it is estimated that the actual number of people who have the disease could be more than twice as many. Although contact tracing now reaches around 80% of identified contacts, teams still cannot reach every community, diagnose every sick person, or deploy response teams where they are needed. As a result, despite important progress, the outbreak continues to outpace the response. The response priorities are to reduce transmission in Ituri by strengthening surveillance, safe and dignified burials, clinical management and community engagement, while rapidly building response capacity in newly affected provinces before transmission becomes established. We face technical challenges, but we also need political action towards a ceasefire to improve humanitarian access and enable the scale-up this response urgently requires. The people of DRC cannot face this outbreak alone. They need sustained support from the international community. And above all, they need peace.

Let's unpack the options for what the US government could do to potentially restrict Chinese AI models: 1. FUD: @deanwball noted the other day that the US government could take a "FUD" approach of just creating lots of doubt and uncertainty about use of Chinese AI, rather than strict legal requirements. (Dean made this point as an analytic matter, he was not advocating for it). The government could issue public security advisories, get sectoral regulators like energy and financial regulators to start raising risks, etc. This might not legally prohibit use, but would likely discourage it. 2. Procurement bans: The U.S. government could use procurement authorities to prohibit the use of Chinese AI models in government contracts, similar to what DoD did to Anthropic earlier this year. This would not prohibit private companies from using Chinese AI models unrelated to government contracts, but it would discourage use and reinforce a FUD approach. 3. Entity List: The Commerce Department could put specific Chinese AI companies (Moonshot, etc.) on the Entity List, which would prohibit exports of US technology to them. Setting aside evasion, this would cut off their access to any remaining US-origin chips not already covered by more general export controls and to US software. It would also potentially complicate U.S. companies’ use of closed or hosted models, as a US company could not send its own software or other "items" to the Chinese company for processing. It would not, however, strictly legally prohibit a U.S. company from downloading an open source model that a Chinese AI company posted online, as the download would not be an export *to* China, but rather an import from it. 4. "ICTS" rule: Commerce's existing "ICTS rule" allows Commerce to restrict the import or US use of a variety of software and other technology that poses a national security risk. Commerce has used the ICTS rule to, inter alia, prevent Americans from using Kaspersky Lab software (from Russia) and it is the basis for the recently-in-the-news restrictions on Polestar autos. Commerce could in theory deploy the rule to prohibit US firms from using Chinese AI models in the US. The one potential caveat to this is that the ICTS Rule exists pursuant to IEEPA, and IEEPA cannot regulate the import (or export) of "information" or "informational materials." I think courts would almost certainly uphold the ICTS rule as applied to the import or use of Chinese-hosted AI models as a prohibition on a “service,” and not on “information.” There would, however, be an interesting question about whether the courts would uphold a ban on a simple US download of an open-source Chinese model, where there was no payment. 5. Sanctions on Chinese AI labs: The President could use IEEPA to impose sanctions on Chinese AI labs, likely after declaring a new national emergency related to adversarial country AI risks. This would block their property in the US and prohibit all US commercial transactions with them. However, IEEPA sanctions would have the same carve out for "information" or "informational materials" as applies to the ICTS rule, and there is some chance the courts would find that IEEPA sanctions cannot prevent a US company from downloading, for free, an open source Chinese model. (Courts, for example, blocked Trump's 2020 use of IEEPA to try to restrict TikTok in the United States). 6. New IEEPA-derived restrictions on US companies using/deploying Chinese AI models: IEEPA is a flexible statute and the Trump Administration could use IEEPA to create new restrictions on the use or deployment of Chinese AI models, for example prohibiting US companies from using the models both in the US and abroad and prohibiting US hyperscalers from making Chinese AI models available in the US or globally. This could either be an outright prohibition, or a restriction, e.g., Chinese models could only be used subject to certain conditions, such as security protocols. (There is some conceptual parallel to how the Department of Justice's Data Security Program works). (There would, however, still be the legal question about whether IEEPA could in fact prevent a US company from simply downloading and using a free Chinese open source model). 7. Congressional legislation: Congress could of course legislate new restrictions on the US use of Chinese AI models. This would avoid the IEEPA limitations discussed above related to “information,” though would still be subject to the First Amendment. I could see the courts upholding a congressional ban on the use of even free open-source AI models despite the first Amendment by finding that such a ban passes “intermediate scrutiny.” (This was part of the basis on which SCOTUS upheld *Congress’s* 2024 legislation requiring a divestment of TikTok after lower courts enjoined Trump’s 2020 IEEPA-based ban). Note: this post is intended solely as a rundown of what the legal options for restrictions are, not a normative argument on what the US government should do. A Party Born in Opposition to Independence Is Now Deciding the Fate of “Joy Bangla”? The chanting of “Joy Bangla” during the funeral prayer of a freedom fighter in Bhairab reportedly triggered overnight police raids. The incident has raised a basic question: what does the law actually say about the slogan? According to a notification issued by the Ministry of Home Affairs in October 2024, the political party Bangladesh Awami League, along with its symbols and banners, was banned. However, the notification does not say that the slogan “Joy Bangla” itself is prohibited. Bangabandhu’s historic slogan represents the spirit of Bangladesh’s Liberation War and is not the property of any single political party. Yet the Bhairab incident suggests that those in power may now be trying to criminalize even the language of liberation. BNP leaders were present at the funeral of Fakhrul Alam, where they praised his contributions and paid tribute to him. But the moment a few mourners chanted “Joy Bangla,” it was allegedly treated as “political provocation.” That reaction raises an obvious question: which part of the slogan is objectionable, “Joy” or “Bangla”? Since August 5, 2024, the article argues, symbols and expressions linked to the Liberation War have increasingly come under attack. The demolition of the historic House No. 32, attacks on museums, and the rise of political successors of those accused of atrocities during the 1971 Liberation War. In that context, it is hardly surprising that “Joy Bangla” has become intolerable to them. During 2001-06, chanting “Joy Bangla” in public could lead to homes being burned, that attacks on religious minorities drew international attention, and that thousands of Awami League activists were killed during Operation Clean Heart. Jamaat-e-Islami was then a coalition partner in government. A similar pattern is now emerging in 2026: Jamaat has returned to Parliament, holds influence within BNP policymaking circles, the Awami League remains banned, and there is a gradual attempt to suppress even the language and symbols associated with the Liberation War. The police operation in Bhairab, sends a clear warning: anyone who chants “Joy Bangla” may face state action. It questions why such a response would come from authorities who, until recently, claimed to stand on the side of the Liberation War. If that is truly the case, the article asks, why should paying final respects to a freedom fighter like Fakhrul Alam with the slogan “Joy Bangla” lead to a police operation? Why the fear? The answer is that those in power fear history itself. It argues that “Joy Bangla” is more than a slogan; it is a pledge, one that those who opposed Bangladesh’s independence in 1971 lost against and, in the article’s view, have been given another chance to challenge after 2024. They fear the slogan because it still has the power to inspire people. Many people across the country believe “Joy Bangla” belongs to the Liberation War, not to any political party. The real question, it says, is whether those in power will accept that truth or continue using nighttime police operations in place of democratic practice. In the end, the slogan raised at Fakhrul Alam’s funeral points to a larger issue: are they opposing the Awami League, or are they opposing the very history of Bangladesh’s independence? #Bangladesh

State-Sponsored Killings in Prison: How Long Will the BNP Continue This Violent Politics of Turning Healthy Detainees into Corpses? The death of Bablu Mia (52), President of Ward No. 9 Awami League in Ratankandi Union, while in custody at Sirajganj District Jail has once again exposed what the text describes as the BNP’s violent political retaliation carried out within state detention facilities. Ignoring the rule of law and the judicial process, opposition leaders and activists are allegedly being arrested on political grounds and subsequently driven toward death through neglect and abuse while in custody. According to the text, this is not an isolated incident but part of a systematic campaign of elimination carried out with state patronage. When Bablu Mia was arrested in a politically motivated case, he was reportedly in good physical health. How, then, did he suddenly die after spending just one month in prison? According to the text, the BNP has been using old and fabricated cases to imprison political opponents, with the objective of mentally and physically crippling them - or ensuring their deaths - making it a tool of the ruling establishment. Ensuring the safety and medical care of political detainees is both a legal and moral responsibility of the state and prison authorities. However, the repeated deaths of political leaders and activists in custody without any judicial process, according to the text, demonstrate that prisons have now been turned into killing grounds for suppressing political opposition under Tarique Rahman’s BNP government.

With its strikes on Moscow, Ukraine is taking disruption to a new level. The success of a long-range strike is not measured by impact alone. Even an intercepted attack closes airspace, disrupts flights and logistics, and erodes the sense of security. Russia cannot protect everything. It has more targets than air defences. Hitting the target magnifies the effect, but disruption begins before destruction. Yes, Russia will continue firing ballistic missiles at Ukrainian cities. But Putin’s problem is that Ukrainian suffering will no longer compensate Russians for disruption at home. As that disruption spreads, Russians will increasingly blame Putin and his corrupt regime for breaking the central bargain underpinning his rule since 2022: war was supposed to be something Ukrainians suffer, not them. The choice is Putin’s: wind down the war to preserve control, or tighten control at home to keep the war going. I would love to be wrong, but everything we know about him suggests he will choose the latter.

Glad to share that #Odisha has been ranked fifth in the country in attracting investment, as per @NITIAayog’s latest ‘Investment Friendliness Index (IFI) Report prepared based on performance in 2023-24. Odisha has an overall score of 52.4% compared to 56.6% of Gujarat. From bankruptcy in 2000, to stand tall among top states in attracting investment across India is immensely satisfactory for me. The turnaround from a laggard state to a beacon state is a story of our sustained reform, fiscal discipline and transformative governance under the principles of #5T which is now being celebrated by present Odisha BJP Government. Odisha has scored ahead of several double engine governments in many parameters while it has emerged as shining beacon in prudent fiscal management across the country, which has been praised by NITI Aayog. Total outstanding liabilities stood at just 16% of Gross State Domestic Product (GSDP), while interest payments were only 1.38% of GSDP, which is lowest across the country. Odisha accounted for nearly half of India’s mineral output and close to a quarter of the nation’s coal production. And I wonder where are the so-called double engine governments? Our sustained effort, policy interventions and discipline have turned the state into a magnet for investment. It has empowered Odisha to invest in people‑centric welfare initiatives. It helped us in investing in pioneering schemes like #BSKY, #KALIA, and #MissionShakti to #SkillDevelopment, #OdishaSchoolTransformation, Tribal welfare, #DisasterManagement, infrastructure development, irrigation projects, poverty alleviation and fund our own food security scheme without waiting for handouts from the Centre. I convey my deepest gratitude to the people of Odisha, whose steadfast partnership has powered this remarkable journey of transformation. I am happy that Odisha BJP is chest thumping the achievement of Biju Janata Dal as its own. But I am worried with the way the Odisha double engine govt is mis-managing finances, it could push the state into same path of bankruptcy which we inherited 25 years back. #BJDforOdisha #GoodGovernance #OdishaLeads

Today we celebrate the birthday of Gustav Hertz, co-recipient of the 1925 @NobelPrize in Physics for the discovery of the laws governing the impact of an electron upon an atom. While working at the University of Berlin in the early 1910s, Hertz performed experiments with his colleague James Franck in which they directed electrons of different energy levels through a gas enclosed in an electron tube. Through this ‘Franck-Hertz experiment’, as it came to be known, they verified for the first time the quantum nature of atoms, meaning that energy can be absorbed by an atom only in definite amounts. This conclusion proved to be consistent with Niels Bohr’s theory on the structure of the atom.

Google DeepMind CEO Demis Hassabis published a framework in July calling on the United States to lead a new standards body to regulate AI. Under the proposal, frontier AI companies would submit their models for review up to 30 days before release. Over that period, those systems would be tested for dangerous cyber, biological, and deceptive capabilities. "But that still leaves much undefined, such as how this body would be financed, whether its access to frontier systems is guaranteed or left to a lab’s discretion, and how its findings might need to be classified," write Elham Tabassi and CFR experts Vinh Nguyen and @rightsduff. "The design choices made to address these problems could decide whether this new body becomes an institution that regulators and the public trust for decades, or one that will need to be rebuilt after its first crisis of confidence," they write.

The United States strongly supports the free and fair development of AI, including a thriving competitive ecosystem that spans frontier models, specialized systems, open-source frameworks, and open-weight models. Legitimate AI distillation used to create smaller, more efficient models plays a vital role in this open innovation ecosystem. However, large-scale, covert industrial distillation aimed at stealing proprietary U.S. technology and undermining American research is unacceptable.

⁨LNG Supply Disruptions Trigger Severe CNG Crisis Across Dhaka --- A disruption in the supply of liquefied natural gas (LNG) has triggered a severe CNG shortage across the capital. Drivers are waiting for hours at filling stations, yet many are unable to get gas. The crisis has caused significant hardship for CNG-powered vehicle drivers, public transport workers, and commuters, while also taking a heavy toll on drivers’ incomes. Visits to several CNG filling stations across Dhaka revealed long queues of vehicles waiting day and night to refuel. At many stations, lines begin forming as early as the night before. Several CNG vehicle drivers said that even after waiting in line from 6:00 a.m. until 1:00 p.m., they are often unable to obtain gas. As a result, they spend a large part of the day at filling stations instead of working, significantly reducing their daily earnings. The crisis has hit low- and middle-income drivers the hardest. Many drivers operating CNG-powered auto-rickshaws and those working with ride-sharing services said they are unable to transport passengers because they cannot refuel on time. Consequently, their daily income has dropped substantially.⁩ #Bangladesh #EnergyCrisis #FuelShortage #BNP

शाश्वत विकास उद्दिष्टांच्या पूर्ततेसाठी परिणामाधारित नियोजन! मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस यांच्या अध्यक्षतेखाली आज सह्याद्री अतिथीगृह, मुंबई येथे सामाजिक क्षेत्र वॉर रूम अंतर्गत नीती आयोगाच्या शाश्वत विकास उद्दिष्टांच्या (SDGs) इंडिया इंडेक्समधील महाराष्ट्राच्या कामगिरीसंदर्भात आढावा बैठक पार पडली. नीती आयोगाने मानवी जीवनावर परिणाम करणाऱ्या विविध निर्देशांकांवर राज्यांमध्ये विकासात्मक स्पर्धा सुरू केली आहे. शाश्वत विकास उद्दिष्टांमधील (एसडीजी) सर्वच निर्देशांकांमध्ये महाराष्ट्राने देशात अव्वल स्थान मिळवावे यासाठी पुढील 4 वर्षांसाठी विभागनिहाय आणि परिणामाधारित नियोजन करावे. तसेच शासनाने आकांक्षित म्हणून जाहीर केलेले 10 जिल्हे व 177 तालुक्यांमध्ये नीती आयोगाच्या निर्देशांकांनुसार मोठ्या प्रमाणात विकासाची कामे करून महाराष्ट्राला सर्वात पुढे ठेवण्याचे निर्देश मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी यावेळी दिले. मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस म्हणाले, गेल्या काही वर्षांत महाराष्ट्र शाश्वत विकास उद्दिष्टांच्या दिशेने महत्त्वपूर्ण वाटचाल करत आहे. महाराष्ट्राची क्षमता लक्षात घेता सन 2030 पर्यंत अधिक वेगाने वाटचाल करण्यासाठी नीती आयोगाच्या विविध निर्देशांकांमध्ये अधिक परिणामकारकपणे काम करण्याची गरज आहे. पुढील 4 वर्षे राज्याच्या विकासासाठी निर्णायक असून या काळात योजनांची पुनर्रचना व बळकटीकरण करावे. या कालावधीत ठोस नियोजन करून महाराष्ट्राला शाश्वत विकास उद्दिष्टांमध्ये देशात अव्वल आणण्यासाठी सर्व विभागांनी एकत्रितपणे प्रयत्न करावेत, असे निर्देश मुख्यमंत्र्यांनी यावेळी दिले. आगामी अर्थसंकल्पीय नियोजन शाश्वत विकास निर्देशांकाच्या उद्दिष्टांच्या पूर्ततेला गती देण्यासाठी उपयोगात आणावे, असेही मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस म्हणाले. मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस म्हणाले, विभागाने आपल्याशी संबंधित निर्देशांकांचा अभ्यास करून प्रगती साधण्यासाठी कार्यपद्धती, धोरणांमध्ये सुधारणा कराव्यात. अग्रक्रमाच्या राज्यांमधील सर्वोत्तम कार्यपद्धती, संकल्पना, धोरणांचा अभ्यास करून राज्याची कामगिरी उंचावण्यावर भर द्यावा. शासन यंत्रणा अधिक सक्षम करण्यासाठी विभागांनी 'रिअल टाइम डेटा'चे संकलन करून त्यावर विश्लेषणात्मक व अन्य राज्यांच्या निर्देशांकासोबत तुलनात्मक अभ्यास करावा. राज्यात डेटा संकलनाची व्यवस्था अधिक मजबूत करण्यात यावी. योजनांच्या अंमलबजावणीचे सतत मूल्यमापन करून तात्काळ आवश्यक सुधारणा करण्यात याव्यात. काही निर्देशांकांमध्ये राज्याच्या प्रत्यक्ष परिस्थितीपेक्षा उपलब्ध आकडेवारी वेगळे चित्र दाखवत असल्यास डेटा गॅप शोधून काढणे आवश्यक आहे. त्यासाठी दुय्यम डेटासोबतच प्राथमिक आणि रिअल टाइम डेटा संकलनाची व्यवस्था अधिक सक्षम करावी. उपलब्ध विविध डेटाबेसेसचे विश्लेषण करून कोणत्या भागात किंवा कोणत्या क्षेत्रात मागे आहोत, हे ओळखून त्यानुसार तातडीने उपाययोजना करणे आवश्यक असल्याचे मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी यावेळी नमूद केले. आरोग्य विभागाच्या माध्यमातून उपचारांची व्यवस्था करण्यात येते. मात्र या व्यवस्थेवर नियंत्रण ठेवून व्यवस्थेपूर्वी असलेली उपचार घेत असलेली रुग्णसंख्या आणि व्यवस्थेनंतरची रुग्णसंख्या, मिळणारे लाभ असा परिणामकेंद्रीत (आउटकम बेसिस) पद्धतीवर आधारित कार्यवाही करावी. त्याचबरोबर आरोग्य, शिक्षण, पायाभूत सुविधा आणि सामाजिक विकास क्षेत्रातील प्रत्यक्ष बदल मोजून धोरणांमध्ये सुधारणा करावी. परिणाम आणि प्रभाव यावर आधारित प्रशासनाची कार्यसंस्कृती विकसित केली जावी. राज्याकडे निधी, मनुष्यबळ आणि प्रशासकीय क्षमतेच्या स्वरूपात विपुल संसाधने उपलब्ध आहेत. या सर्व संसाधनांचा अधिक प्रभावी वापर करून नागरिकांच्या जीवनमानात सुधारणा घडवून आणल्या जाव्यात. सध्याची धोरणे आणि कार्यपद्धती यांच्या अंमलबजावणीमधील कमतरता, त्रुटी शोधून त्या दूर करण्यासाठी प्रयत्न करावेत. ज्या क्षेत्रातील निर्देशांकामध्ये राज्य पुढे आहे, त्या क्षेत्राच्या प्रगतीमध्ये सातत्य ठेवावे, असे निर्देश मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी यावेळी दिले. नीती आयोगाने दिलेले शाश्वत विकास निर्देशांक (एसडीजी) डोळ्यासमोर ठेवून विकासाचे नियोजन करावे. नीती आयोगाने दिलेल्या निर्देशांकातील प्रगतीचा आढावा यापुढे दर 3 महिन्यांनी घेण्यात यावा. तसेच मुख्य सचिव यांच्या स्तरावरही नियमित निरीक्षण केले जावे, असे निर्देश मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी यावेळी दिले. राज्याच्या आकांक्षित क्षेत्रात झालेल्या गुंतवणुकीतून होणाऱ्या परिणामांचा नियमित आढावा घेतला पाहिजे. एसडीजी उद्दिष्टांवरील कामगिरी ही सर्व अधिकाऱ्यांच्या APAR (Annual Performance Appraisal Report) प्रणालीत प्रमुख कामगिरी निर्देशांक (केपीआय) अनिवार्य करण्यात यावा, असे मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी यावेळी सांगितले. ऊर्जा, शाश्वत शहरे आणि अन्य काही क्षेत्रांमध्ये महाराष्ट्राची कामगिरी चांगली असून त्यामध्ये सातत्य ठेवावे. तसेच ज्या क्षेत्रांमध्ये राज्य मागे पडलेले आहे, त्या क्षेत्रांतील त्रुटी शोधून त्यावर लक्ष केंद्रित करावे. प्रत्येक विभागाने आपल्या निर्देशांकांवर सखोल काम करून डेटा विश्लेषण करावे, असे निर्देशही मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी यावेळी दिले. यावेळी वरिष्ठ अधिकारी उपस्थित होते. The ASEAN Post-Ministerial Conference (PMC) with New Zealand was convened in Manila on 22 July 2026. The Meeting was attended by the ASEAN Foreign Ministers or their representatives, Minister of Foreign Affairs of New Zealand, Winston Peters, and representative from the ASEAN Secretariat. The Meeting reaffirmed the commitment of ASEAN and New Zealand to further deepening cooperation under the ASEAN–New Zealand Comprehensive Strategic Partnership (CSP), established last year. The Ministers reviewed progress of cooperation and discussed ways to advance collaboration including the implementation of the ASEAN–New Zealand Plan of Action (2026–2030), as well as exchanged views on regional and international developments.

The ASEAN Post-Ministerial Conference with Russia was held in Manila on 22 July 2026. The Meeting reaffirmed the shared commitment of both sides to further strengthen the Strategic Partnership and chart its future direction, in the context of the 35th anniversary of ASEAN-Russia relations this year. In this regard, the Meeting welcomed the adoption of the Comprehensive Plan of Action to Implement ASEAN-Russian Federation Strategic Partnership (2026-2030) at the recent ASEAN-Russia Commemorative Summit held in June 2026 in Kazan, Russia, together with the Kazan Declaration 2026: “ASEAN-Russian Federation: Unity in Diversity – 35 Years Together”, the Joint Statement of ASEAN and the Russian Federation on Energy Cooperation, and the Joint Statement of ASEAN and the Russian Federation on Cultural Cooperation, which collectively provide strategic guidance for the partnership in the years ahead. The Meeting was attended by ASEAN Foreign Ministers or their representatives, Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Russian Federation, Sergey Lavrov, and Deputy Secretary-General of ASEAN for ASEAN Political-Security Community, Dato' Astanah Abdul Aziz.

A Trilateral Meeting involving the ASEAN Chair, the Philippines, Türkiye, and the ASEAN Secretariat was convened in Manila on 22 July 2026. The Meeting was chaired by the Undersecretary for Policy and Philippine ASEAN SOM Leader, Leo M. Herrera-Lim, and attended by the Deputy Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Türkiye, Berris Ekinci, and Deputy Secretary-General of ASEAN for ASEAN Political-Security Community, Dato’ Astanah Abdul Aziz. The Meeting reaffirmed its commitment to further strengthening the ASEAN–Türkiye partnership following the conferment of Dialogue Partner status on Türkiye, and exchanged views on opportunities to deepen cooperation and chart the future direction of ASEAN–Türkiye relations.

Celebrating a legacy in Earth Observation! 🎉 🚀 On July 23, 1972, Landsat 1 launched into orbit and changed the way we see our planet. As the first satellite in what would become the world’s longest-running Earth observing program, Landsat 1 began a legacy of continuous, trusted, and scientifically valuable land imaging that still supports research, decision making, and stewardship today. Within days of the launch, Landsat 1 acquired an image of an astounding 81,000-acre (327.8 square kilometers) fire burning in isolated, central Alaska. For the first time ever, scientists and resource management officials were able to see the full extent of damage from a fire in a single image while it was still burning. Landsat 1 marked the beginning of a long partnership between the USGS and NASA that continues today. NASA developed, launched, and operated the satellite, while the USGS helped shape its scientific objectives and established the EROS Data Center to archive and distribute its imagery. Together, the two agencies laid the foundation for the enduring Landsat program. From that first launch to the missions operating today, and those planned for the future, Landsat represents more than five decades of innovation, collaboration, and watching Earth change. Here’s to where it all began! 🛰️🌎 🔗 Learn more about the first Landsat mission: ow.ly/RF1I50Zrrte 📸1: Landsat 1 launched July 23, 1972, aboard a Delta 0900 rocket from Vandenberg Air Force Base in California. Credit: NASA 📸2: Smoke from a large wildfire in a central Alaska can be seen on this false color image acquired by Landsat 1 on July 27, 1972. Credit: USGS #EarthObservation #LandsatLegacy

National water availability data at your fingertips! 💧🎉 The National Water Availability Assessment Data Companion provides regularly updated, model-based estimates of water availability and use on a national scale. Nearly 27 million Americans, or 8% of the U.S. population, live in areas where water demand consistently approaches or exceeds naturally available water supply. Until recently, accessing comprehensive water availability information with national coverage required stitching together disparate datasets across multiple agencies, regions, and complicated websites. The Data Companion eliminates these barriers by: 💧 Providing consistent information about water availability and use across approximately 80,000 watersheds nationwide from 2000 to 2020 💧 Enabling data access through various user-friendly means, including a subset and download tool, a data file directory, an API, and a new interactive map 💧 Continually adding new and updated data to reflect the latest USGS water models and science Check out the interactive map now: water.usgs.gov/nwaa-data/ 📷 1: View of soil moisture data for January 2020 across the lower 48 United States from the Data Companion web mapper.

মাত্র এক সপ্তাহ পরই নতুন জীবনের পথে পা রাখার কথা ছিল তাজবিকের। ফিনল্যান্ডের একটি বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়ে ভর্তিও হয়েছিলেন। উচ্চশিক্ষার জন্য সেখানে পাড়ি জমানোর আগে সপরিবারের ওমরাহ করতে যাচ্ছিলেন। কিন্তু সৌদির সড়কে মা এবং বোনের সঙ্গে নিভে গেল তার প্রাণ প্রদীপ! একই গাড়িতে থাকলেও অলৌকিকভাবে বেঁচে গেছেন বাবা এবং বড় ভাই। বিস্তারিত : বৃহস্পতিবার (২৩ জুলাই) সকাল সকাল রিয়াদের বাসা থেকে নিজেদের গাড়িতে করে তিন ছেলে-মেয়ে ও স্ত্রীকে নিয়ে মক্কার উদ্দেশ্যে রওনা হন শফিকুল ইসলাম শফিক। গাড়ি তিনিই চালাচ্ছিলেন। তার পাশেই সামনের আসনে বসেছিলেন বড় ছেলে নাবিল। আর পেছনের আসনে পাশাপাশি বসেছিলেন মা তানিয়া তাহমিনা রিনা (৪৫), মেজ ছেলে তাজবিক (১৭) এবং ছোট মেয়ে সাদাফ (১৫)। কিন্তু তাদের সেই ওমরাহ যাত্রা আর গন্তব্য পায়নি। বরং পাঁচজনের পরিবারের তিনজনেরই শেষ যাত্রায় পরিণত হয়। রিয়াদ থেকে আনুমানিক ২০০ কিলোমিটার যাওয়ার পর ভয়াবহ সড়ক দুর্ঘটনার কবলে পড়ে তাদের গাড়ি। পরিবারের ধারণা, পেছন থেকে কোনো ভারী যানবাহন তাদের গাড়িতে সজোরে ধাক্কা দেয়। ফলে পেছনের সিটে বসা তিনজনই ঘটনাস্থলে মারা যান। অলৌকিকভাবে গাড়ির সামনে থাকা বাবা ও বড় ছেলে বেঁচে যান ঠিকই, কিন্তু চোখের সামনে স্ত্রী ও দুই সন্তানের মর্মান্তিক মৃত্যুতে দিশেহারা হয়ে পড়েছেন তারা। নিহত রিনা ফরিদপুরের সালথা উপজেলার আটঘর ইউনিয়নের সাবেক চেয়ারম্যান নাজিমুদ্দিন মোল্লার মেয়ে। প্রায় দুই দশক ধরে তিনি স্বামীর সঙ্গে রিয়াদে বসবাস করছিলেন। তার স্বামী সেখানে একটি বেসরকারি প্রতিষ্ঠানের উচ্চপদে কর্মরত। রিনার ভাই তৌহিদ মোহাম্মদ মুরাদ সময় নিউজকে বলেন, ‘‘মেজ ছেলেটা ’এ’ লেভেল শেষ করে ফিনল্যান্ডের একটি বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়ে ভর্তি হয়েছিল। আর এক সপ্তাহ পরই তার ফ্লাইট ছিল। সে চলে যাওয়ার আগে সবাই মিলে ওমরাহ করতে যাচ্ছিল।’’ তিনি জানান, পরিবারের বড় ছেলে নর্থ সাউথ বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়ে পড়াশোনা করছেন। আর ছোট মেয়ে এবার ও-লেভেল পরীক্ষার্থী ছিল। মুরাদের ভাষ্য, ‘সম্ভবত পেছন থেকে কোনো বড় গাড়ি এসে ধাক্কা দেয়। তাই পেছনের সিটে থাকা তিনজনই মারা যায়।’ তিনি আরও জানান, দুর্ঘটনার পর স্বজনদের কাছে খবর পৌঁছাতে বেশ সময় লেগেছে। ঘটনাস্থল রিয়াদ থেকে প্রায় ২০০ কিলোমিটার দূরে হওয়ায় এক আত্মীয় সেখানে পৌঁছাতেই প্রায় তিন ঘণ্টা লেগে যায়। সব মিলিয়ে বিকেল সাড়ে ৫টার দিকে তারা মৃত্যুর খবর নিশ্চিত হতে পারেন। স্বামী ও বড় ছেলে শারীরিকভাবে আশঙ্কামুক্ত হলেও তারা গভীর মানসিক ট্রমার মধ্যে রয়েছেন বলে জানান মুরাদ। নিহতদের মরদেহ দেশে আনা হবে কি না, সে বিষয়ে এখনো কোনো সিদ্ধান্ত হয়নি। পরিবারের পক্ষ থেকে বাংলাদেশ দূতাবাসের সঙ্গে যোগাযোগের চেষ্টা চলছে বলে জানিয়েছেন তৌহিদ মোহাম্মদ মুরাদ। #Umrah #SaudiArabia #RoadAccident #somoytv

🤝 CM Devendra Fadnavis presided over the signing and exchange of MoUs between Sahakar Taxi Co-Operative Limited (STCL) and various organisations. List of organisations: 🔸Maharashtra State Road Transport Corporation (MSRTC) 🔸Navi Mumbai Traffic Police 🔸Mumbai Traffic Police 🔸Thane Municipal Corporation 🔸Navi Mumbai Municipal Corporation 🔸Municipal Corporation of Greater Mumbai 🔸Thane Traffic Police 🔸M/s. Loknete D B Patil Native Project Affected Transport Co-Operative Limited 🔸Cosmos Co-operative Bank Ltd Purpose of these MoUs: ✅To enhance last-mile and first-mile connectivity for MSRTC passengers, improve the overall commuter experience at bus stands via dedicated prepaid systems and promote integrated, sustainable green urban mobility across Maharashtra ✅To provide seamless last-mile connectivity to MSRTC passengers at designated bus stands via the Bharat Taxi platform ✅To establish structured physical prepaid booths at principal transit junctions to cater to walk-in passengers ✅To advance sustainable transport paradigms via structural co-branding layouts on the City Electric Buses and long-distance MSRTC transit fleets ✅To ensure safe, affordable, and accessible transport for all commuters, including women, senior citizens and persons with disabilities ✅To enhance commuter security via tracked, cashless, app-based taxi operations, integrate digital emergency response networks and regulate dedicated taxi facilitation zones ✅To improve urban mobility in the corporation's jurisdiction through safe, organised, app-based and cashless taxi services ✅To enhance first-mile and last-mile connectivity at public transport hubs and high-footfall civic locations; promote green and electric mobility and support TMC, NMMC, MCGM's Smart City and digital governance initiatives ✅To outline the strategic partnership between the Parties for the commercial rollout and day-to-day management of the ‘Bharat Taxi’ platform within the precinct of NMIA Union MoS Murlidhar Mohol, Minister Babasaheb Patil, MLA Manda Mhatre, MLA Mahesh Baldi, MLA Prashant Thakur and other dignitaries were present. 🤝 मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस यांच्या प्रमुख उपस्थितीत सहकार टॅक्सी को-ऑपरेटिव्ह लिमिटेड (STCL) आणि विविध संस्थांदरम्यान सामंजस्य करार (MoU) करण्यात आले. सामंजस्य करार झालेल्या संस्था : 🔸 महाराष्ट्र राज्य मार्ग परिवहन महामंडळ (MSRTC) 🔸 नवी मुंबई वाहतूक पोलीस 🔸 मुंबई वाहतूक पोलीस 🔸 ठाणे महानगरपालिका (TMC) 🔸 नवी मुंबई महानगरपालिका (NMMC) 🔸 बृहन्मुंबई महानगरपालिका (MCGM) 🔸 ठाणे वाहतूक पोलीस 🔸 लोकनेते स्व. दि. बा. पाटील नेटिव्ह प्रोजेक्ट अफेक्टेड ट्रान्सपोर्ट को-ऑपरेटिव्ह लिमिटेड 🔸 कॉसमॉस को-ऑपरेटिव्ह बँक लिमिटेड सामंजस्य करारांची उद्दिष्टे: ✅ MSRTC प्रवाशांसाठी प्रथम टप्प्यातील (First-mile) आणि अंतिम टप्प्यातील (Last-mile) प्रवास अधिक सुलभ करणे, बसस्थानकांवर प्रीपेड टॅक्सी व्यवस्था उपलब्ध करून प्रवाशांचा प्रवास अधिक सोयीस्कर बनवणे तसेच महाराष्ट्रात एकात्मिक, शाश्वत आणि पर्यावरणपूरक शहरी वाहतूक व्यवस्थेला चालना देणे ✅ भारत टॅक्सी प्लॅटफॉर्मच्या माध्यमातून निश्चित MSRTC बसस्थानकांवर प्रवाशांना अखंड लास्ट-माईल कनेक्टिव्हिटी उपलब्ध करून देणे ✅ थेट येणाऱ्या प्रवाशांची सोय करण्यासाठी प्रमुख वाहतूक केंद्रांवर सुव्यवस्थित आणि कायमस्वरूपी 'प्रीपेड' बुथ्स उभारणे. ✅ शहरातील इलेक्ट्रिक बसेस आणि एमएसआरटीसीच्या लांब पल्ल्याच्या बस ताफ्यावर संरचित संयुक्त ब्रँडिंगद्वारे शाश्वत वाहतूक व्यवस्थेला प्रोत्साहन देणे. ✅ महिला, ज्येष्ठ नागरिक आणि दिव्यांगांसह सर्व प्रवाशांसाठी सुरक्षित, परवडणारी आणि विश्वासार्ह टॅक्सी सेवा उपलब्ध करून देणे. ✅ ट्रॅकिंग सुविधा, कॅशलेस व ॲप-आधारित टॅक्सी सेवांद्वारे प्रवाशांच्या सुरक्षिततेला बळकटी देणे. डिजिटल आपत्कालीन प्रतिसाद प्रणालीशी समन्वय साधणे. तसेच नियोजित टॅक्सी सुविधा क्षेत्रांचे (Taxi Facilitation Zones) प्रभावी नियमन करणे. ✅ महानगरपालिकेच्या क्षेत्रात सुरक्षित, नियोजित, ॲप-आधारित आणि कॅशलेस टॅक्सी सेवांद्वारे शहरी वाहतूक व्यवस्था अधिक सक्षम करणे. ✅ सार्वजनिक वाहतूक केंद्र आणि नागरिकांची मोठी वर्दळ असलेल्या ठिकाणी फर्स्ट-माईल व लास्ट-माईल कनेक्टिव्हिटी वाढवणे, हरित व इलेक्ट्रिक मोबिलिटीला प्रोत्साहन देणे तसेच TMC, NMMC आणि MCGM यांच्या स्मार्ट सिटी व डिजिटल गव्हर्नन्स उपक्रमांना बळकटी देणे. ✅ नवी मुंबई आंतरराष्ट्रीय विमानतळ (NMIA) परिसरात ‘भारत टॅक्सी’ प्लॅटफॉर्मच्या The deal has been de-linked from Saudi normalization with Israel A civil nuclear energy cooperation agreement with the United States has been something of a Holy Grail for Saudi Arabia’s Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman. For the United States, it had both pros and cons: a chance to ensure Saudi nuclear energy would be developed with US technology; the opportunity to impose strict safeguards to prevent nuclear enrichment to support a nuclear-weapons program; the risk of other major players in the Middle East—Egypt, Turkey, certainly Iran—feeling they must match the Saudi capabilities, setting off at least a nuclear-technology race; potential threats to the security of Israel and other US partners. Weighing all these factors, the Biden administration set out to negotiate such an agreement, building in strict safeguards to prevent enrichment that could fuel a nuclear weapons program, consulting carefully with Israel, and embedding the agreement in a larger package including normalization with Israel, a credible pathway to a Palestinian state, and US and Saudi mutual-defense commitments. A deal was nearly finalized in mid-2024, pending an end to the war in Gaza. Now the Trump administration has decided to proceed with such a deal. But it is not clear if it imposed the requirement for the same strict safeguards; details have yet to be revealed. What is certain is that the agreement has been de-linked from Saudi normalization with Israel, which is not ready to proceed, particularly while the current Israeli government is unwilling to engage on the question of a Palestinian state. That means the United States has played a valuable card that could have been held back to be used as an incentive for normalizing relations with Israel. Perhaps the Trump administration is using this agreement to smooth over differences with the Saudis over the war with Iran, or to secure Saudi cooperation in military operations. If so, it would be evidence that the United States is prepared to sacrifice one strategic opportunity in order to plug another strategic hole, with a possible painful opportunity cost. — @DanielBShapiro is a distinguished fellow with the Atlantic Council’s Scowcroft Middle East Security Initiative. He has previously served as US deputy assistant secretary of defense for the Middle East and US ambassador to Israel.

Luton, UK: Shaykh-ul-Islam Dr Muhammad Tahir-ul-Qadri Delivers Keynote Address at "Shan-e-Ahl-e-Bait-e-Nabvi ﷺ Conference" His Eminence Shaykh-ul-Islam Dr Muhammad Tahir-ul-Qadri, founding leader of Minhaj-ul-Quran International, delivered the keynote address at the "Shan-e-Ahl-e-Bait-e-Nabviﷺ Conference", organised on the occasion of the "Ta'ziyati Reference of Pir Syed Abdul Qadir Shah Jillani (R.A)" under the auspices of Markazi Jama'at-e-Ahle Sunnat (UK & Overseas) at Jamia Islamia Ghousia Trust, Luton. Addressing a large gathering of scholars, community leaders and students of knowledge, Shaykh-ul-Islam delivered a profound Qur’anic exposition of Ayat al-Tatheer (The Verse of Purification) from Surah al-Ahzab (33:33): اِنَّمَا یُرِیْدُ اللهُ لِیُذْهِبَ عَنْکُمُ الرِّجْسَ اَهْلَ الْبَیْتِ وَیُطَہِّرَکُمْ تَطْہِیْرًا “Stay in your homes and do not display your charm, like the displaying of the former (days of) ignorance. Establish the prayer, pay the alms due and keep obeying Allah and His Messenger (ﷺ). Indeed, Allah only desires to keep all (forms and causes of) impurity away from you, O Members of the (Prophet’s) Family, and purify you with a thorough purifying.” Shaykh-ul-Islam explained that this blessed verse is a clear and unequivocal declaration of the unique rank, spiritual excellence and divinely bestowed purity of the blessed Ahl al-Bayt (ʿalayhim al-salām). He stated that Almighty Allah Himself has declared His exclusive will to remove every form of rijs—including every impurity, spiritual defect, doubt, moral corruption and anything contrary to goodness—and to grant them complete and perfect taṭhīr. Explaining the Qur’anic language, Shaykh-ul-Islam emphasised that the verse is not merely a command for the Ahl al-Bayt to attain purity through their own efforts. Rather, it is a decisive declaration that Allah ﷻ Himself undertook their complete purification. This divine act establishes their honour, purity and spiritual rank through the Qur’an itself. He further explained that the emphatic expression “وَيُطَهِّرَكُمْ تَطْهِيرًا” signifies not an ordinary form of purification but a complete, perfect and divinely bestowed purification encompassing every aspect of their belief, intentions, character, conduct, sacrifice and spiritual excellence. He stressed that the sacrifices of the Ahl al-Bayt, particularly the events of Karbala, must be understood through this Qur’anic declaration rather than through political or worldly interpretations. What can four decades of land cover data reveal? A changing landscape. The latest release of the Annual National Land Cover Database (NLCD) extends annual mapping through 2025, providing a longer view of how landscapes across the United States have changed over time. One example is the Great Salt Lake in Utah. In the mid-1980s, the lake’s water levels reached historic highs. Since then, water levels have fluctuated over the years but have declined overall. Built from Landsat imagery, Annual NLCD maps land cover across the United States each year, helping researchers, government agencies, businesses, and communities better understand how landscapes are changing. Learn more about the latest Annual NLCD release, including how to access and download the data: 👉ow.ly/yPls50ZqOWp 🎥: Animation showing Annual NLCD maps of the Great Salt Lake area in Utah (1985 to 2025). Darker blue represents open water, while lighter blues represent wetlands. Shades of green signify various types of forests. Shades of red represent developed areas, including cities and roads, with darker shades indicating more intense development. Light tan is grassland; darker tan is shrub/scrub land cover; yellow is pasture/hay; and brown is cropland. Gray is barren land. Video

Impact assessments under IFAD12 also found average increases of: 🔹 34% in participants’ incomes 🔹 35% in production 🔹 34% in market access As an international financial institution, IFAD combines Member States contributions, domestic and international co-financing, and sovereign and private-sector investment to scale impact. Historically, every US$1 in donor contributions has translated into approximately US$6 of investment on the ground. At a time of greater scrutiny over development finance, these results show that focused, evidence-based investment in rural people delivers measurable impact, value for money and greater resilience and stability. Today's Ramsar Spotlight takes us to Deepor Beel in Assam. For generations, Deepor Beel has been home to communities including the Bodo, Karbi, Garo, Rabha, Khasi and Assamese-speaking people. India is reportedly committing $2 billion to military drone procurement over the next two years. But the bigger challenge is not the money — it is the model. Tactical drones evolve faster than any standard procurement cycle can accommodate, and a one-off purchase approach leaves armed forces holding obsolete fleets while vendors struggle with unpredictable demand. In this Discussion Document, Adya Madhavan (@adyamadhavan) and Vikrant Shinde propose a Supply, Service, and Upgrade contract model that treats drone procurement like a service agreement rather than a transaction, enabling sustained capability upgrades, predictable vendor order books, and a more resilient domestic drone ecosystem. اسلام آباد: 23 جولائی، 2026. وزیراعظم محمد شہباز شریف کی زیر صدارت ملک میں بہبود آبادی کے حوالے سے اہم جائزہ اجلاس آج اسلام آباد میں منعقد ہوا. اجلاس سے گفتگو کرتے ہوئے وزیرِ اعظم نے کہا کہ تیزی سے بڑھتی ہوئی آبادی ملک کے لئے سب سے بڑا چیلنج ہے. بڑھتی ہوئی آبادی پر قابو پانے کے لئے اقدامات اور بہبود آبادی کو قومی فریضہ سمجھا جانا چاہئے. آبادی میں توازن ہی پائیدار قومی ترقی کی ضمانت ہے. آبادی کی منصوبہ بندی کو قومی ترقی، معاشی استحکام اور انسانی وسائل کی بہتری سے ہم آہنگ کرنے کی ضرورت ہے. بہبود آبادی کے اقدامات کے حوالے سے صوبوں کے ساتھ روابط اور ہم آہنگی کو مزید بہتر بنایا جائے. بڑھتی ہوئی آبادی پر قابو پانے کے مؤثر عوامی آگہی مہم کا کلیدی کردار ہے. وزیراعظم نے نیشنل پاپولیشن کونسل کا اجلاس جلد از جلد بلانے کی ہدایت کی. اجلاس کو ملک کی بڑھتی ہوئی آبادی، بہبود آبادی اور نیشنل پاپولیشن کونسل کے اجلاس کی تیاریوں کے حوالے سے بریفنگ دی گئی. بریفنگ میں بتایا گیا کہ نیشنل پاپولیشن کونسل کا اجلاس جلد بلایا جائے گا جس میں تمام صوبوں، گلگت بلتستان کے وزراء اعلیٰ، آزاد جموں و کشمیر کے وزیراعظم اور دیگر تمام متعلقہ اداروں کے نمائندے اور اسٹیک ہولڈرز شرکت کریں گے تاکہ بہبود آبادی کے حوالےسے جامع حکمت عملی ترتیب دی جاسکے. نیشنل پاپولیشن کونسل سیکریٹریٹ کے آپریٹنگ طریقہء کار کو تیار کر لیا گیا ہے. نیشنل سٹیبلائزیشن پلان 2026-2035 تیار کیا جا رہا ہے جس میں ابادی بڑھنے کی رفتار کو کم کرنے کے حوالے سے قومی فریم ورک پیش کیا جائے گا. اس پلان کے تحت پاپولیشن گروتھ ریٹ کو موجودہ 2.55 فیصد سے کم کر کے 2035 تک 1.25 فیصد تک لے جانے کا ہدف رکھا جا رہا ہے. اجلاس کو مزید بتایا گیا کہ پاپولیشن سٹیبلائیزشن کے نئے فریم ورک کے تحت صحت ، تعلیم ، نوجوان آبادی ، لیبر فورس میں خواتین کی تعداد میں اضافے ، پیشہ ورانہ تربیت اور سماجی تحفظ پر توجہ مرکوز کی جائے گی. وفاقی حکومت کے سماجی تحفظ کے کئی اقدامات کو بہبود آبادی سے مشروط کرنے کے حوالے سے کام کا آغاز کردیا گیا ہے. اجلاس میں وفاقی وزیر منصوبہ بندی احسن اقبال، وفاقی وزیر اقتصادی امور احد خان چیمہ، وفاقی وزیر قومی صحت سید مصطفیٰ کمال, وفاقی وزیر اطلاعات و نشریات عطاء اللہ تارڑ اور متعلقہ اعلیٰ سرکاری افسران نے شرکت کی ۔ Video

Islamabad : 23 July, 2026. Prime Minister Muhammad Shehbaz Sharif held a telephone conversation with His Royal Highness Prince Mohammed bin Salman bin Abdulaziz Al Saud, Crown Prince and Prime Minister of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, this morning. During their most cordial conversation, the Prime Minister expressed Pakistan’s condemnation, in the strongest possible terms, of the dastardly attacks carried out by the Houthi militia against Saudi oil tankers in the Red Sea. He added that such actions were totally unacceptable, constitute a clear violation of international law, threaten freedom of navigation and commercial shipping, and undermine regional peace, security, and stability. The Prime Minister reaffirmed Pakistan’s complete solidarity with the brotherly Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and stated that he, along with Field Marshal Syed Asim Munir, and the entire Pakistani nation, stands firmly and resolutely with the Saudi leadership and brotherly people of the Kingdom at this critical time. He reiterated Pakistan’s unwavering support for the Kingdom’s security, sovereignty, territorial integrity, and prosperity. The Prime Minister assured His Royal Highness Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman that Pakistan would continue to work very closely with the Kingdom, as well as with the international community, in support of peace, security, stability, and the uninterrupted flow of lawful maritime commerce in the Red Sea, Strait of Hormuz and the wider region . His Royal Highness Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman appreciated Pakistan’s steadfast support and the close fraternal ties between the two countries. Availing himself of the opportunity, the Prime Minister conveyed his warm regards and best wishes to the Custodian of the Two Holy Mosques, His Majesty King Salman bin Abdulaziz Al Saud.

On a freezing December morning in 1957, President Dwight D. Eisenhower was reviewing budget proposals when his secretary nervously informed him that a 73-year-old woman named Mrs. Eleanor Mitchell from Abilene, Kansas—his childhood Sunday school teacher—was in the White House lobby asking to see him without an appointment, and instead of having staff politely redirect her, Eisenhower literally ran down the hallway, swept this elderly woman into a huge bear hug, and cleared his entire afternoon to have tea with her in the residence. What makes this moment so breathtakingly beautiful is that Mrs. Mitchell had taught a scrappy young Dwight Eisenhower Bible verses every Sunday from 1907 to 1911 in a tiny church basement, making him memorize Proverbs and Psalms when he'd rather be playing baseball, and she'd written him letters throughout his military career—through both world conflicts, through his rise to Supreme Commander, through his election—always addressing him simply as 'Dwight' and reminding him that 'character matters more than rank.' Eisenhower told his staff that Mrs. Mitchell once made him apologize to the entire Sunday school class for being prideful after he'd bragged about winning a spelling bee, teaching him a humility lesson that shaped his entire leadership philosophy, and he'd never forgotten how she'd pulled him aside afterward and said, 'Dwight, you're going to do important things someday, but never let success make you forget where you came from or who helped you along the way.' During their White House tea, Eisenhower introduced Mrs. Mitchell to every cabinet member who passed by, saying with genuine reverence, 'This woman taught me everything that matters—respect this lady,' and she gently scolded him for not attending church regularly enough, which made the most powerful man in the world laugh and promise to do better. When Mrs. Mitchell left that evening, Eisenhower walked her personally to her taxi, kissed her cheek, and pressed an envelope into her hand containing a check for her church and a note: ‘For the place that built my foundation—thank you for seeing potential in a troublemaker farm boy. Your student always, Dwight.' What absolutely destroys you is understanding that Eisenhower commanded armies and led nations, but he never forgot the Sunday school teacher who taught him that true strength was moral courage, proving that the greatest leaders never outgrow gratitude and that honoring the people who shaped you when nobody knew your name is the most presidential thing you can do.

India's mobile internet story is one of the great infrastructure achievements of the last decade. Over 1 billion broadband connections. Mobile data costs a fraction of what it does in most countries. But a new policy brief by @aarti_ready, Shailly Gupta, and @malikpayal at @ICRIER argues there's a hidden gap worth examining.🧵👇

📰 ICRIER in the News A recent article in the @zerodha Daily Brief cites an ICRIER policy brief, From Mobile-First to Mobile-Plus, making the case that India's mobile-heavy internet lacks the fixed-line fibre backbone its digital future depends on. Despite crossing 1 billion broadband connections, less than 5% run on fixed wireline — and India is one of the few countries where mobile networks carry more total data than fixed-line ones. As cloud AI, telemedicine and digital governance scale up, the brief argues, the absence of a reliable fibre backbone becomes a structural vulnerability. The brief points to a core design flaw: with over ₹1 lakh crore sitting unutilised as of March 2026, funds collected for broadband expansion get stuck in the budgetary pipeline. Its central fix is to ringfence the Digital Bharat Nidhi, alongside accelerating BSNL's copper-to-fibre conversion and mandating wholesale infrastructure access. The two leaders discussed Pakistan–Australia bilateral relations and reaffirmed their commitment to further strengthening cooperation, including through regular high-level engagement. They also exchanged views on regional and international developments. Foreign Minister Wong appreciated Pakistan’s constructive role in promoting dialogue and de-escalation. Both sides noted with concern the recent escalations in the region and stressed that dialogue, diplomacy, and respect for international law remain essential to achieving lasting peace, stability, and security.

The two leaders reviewed Pakistan–New Zealand bilateral relations and reaffirmed their commitment to strengthening cooperation in trade and investment, sports, and people-to-people exchanges. They also emphasized enhancing institutional linkages, regular engagement, and high-level exchanges. They exchanged views on regional and international developments. کشت خشخاش پیش از افغانستان در ایران و کشورهای دیگر منطقه صورت می‌گرفت. شروع کشت خشخاش در افغانستان به‌طور دقیق مشخص نیست، اما شواهد تاریخی نشان می‌دهد که سابقه‌ای بسیار طولانی و پیچیده دارد. تریاک هزاران سال پیش در حوزه‌ی مدیترانه و آسیای غربی شناخته شده بود و بعدها به سرزمین‌های مختلف، از جمله ایران، هند، چین و افغانستان راه پیدا کرد. افغانستان نه خاستگاه اولیه‌ی خشخاش است و نه نخستین کشوری که آن را کشت کرده است. خشخاش از گذشته‌های دور به‌صورت ناچیز و برای دارو تولید می‌شده است. هیچ افغانستانی منکر آن نیست که کشورش در دهه‌های اخیر با معضل تولید و قاچاق تریاک دست‌وپنجه نرم کرده است. منابع مختلف، روایت‌های گوناگونی در مورد ورود آن به افغانستان ارائه داده‌اند. دیدگاه غالب این است که خشخاش از طریق ایران و شرق مدیترانه وارد افغانستان شده است. برخی پژوهشگران معتقد اند خشخاش از طریق بخارا و جاده‌ی ابریشم به افغانستان راه یافته است. واژه‌ی تریاک ریشه‌ی یونانی دارد. براساس فرضیه‌ی تاریخی، ممکن است سربازان اسکندر مقدونی تریاک را در حدود ۳۳۰ سال قبل از میلاد به افغانستان و هند معرفی کرده باشند. روایت دیگر، ورود این گیاه را به زمان حملات مغولان نسبت می‌دهد. از سویی، نام دیگر تریاک در افغانستان «کوکنار»، واژه‌ای ترکی است و این مسأله نشان می‌دهد این گیاه بومی نبوده و از طریق تعاملات فرهنگی و تجاری از کشورهای دیگر وارد شده است. اما تبدیل شدن افغانستان به یکی از بزرگ‌ترین تولیدکنندگان تریاک در دنیا، محصول جنگ، فروپاشی اقتصاد، فقر و ضعف نهادهای حکومتی است، نه بخشی از هویت تاریخی مردم این کشور. بیشتر بخوانید: etilaatroz.com/257811

جامعه‌ی قبیله‌ای پشتون برای سده‌ها رفتارهای اجتماعی و قضایی خود را بر پایه‌ آیین‌نامه‌ای نانوشته، اما بسیار سخت‌گیرانه، به نام پشتونوالی تنظیم کرده است. پشتونوالی فراتر از یک آیین، به قانون اساسی روانی و رفتاری قوم پشتون شهرت دارد. بااین‌حال، کالبدشکافی رفتار «امارت اسلامی» نشان می‌دهد که ایدئولوژی طالبانی، در عمل، همین کدهای اخلاقی را از درون تهی و ویران کرده است. پشتونوالی نظام ارزشی و کهن قبیله‌ای است که بر اصولی چون مهمان‌نوازی (ملمستیا)، پناه‌دهی (ننواتی)، غیرت و ناموس، شورا و جرگه‌محوری، و عدالت قبیله‌ای استوار است. این نظام هزاران سال پیش از تولد طالبان وجود داشته و متعلق به کل قوم پشتون است، نه یک گروه سیاسی خاص. آنچه در دودهه‌ی اخیر رخ داده، تلاش طالبان برای گره زدن روایت خودشان به این میراث مشترک بوده است. طالبان با ترکیب گزینشی از پشتونوالی و قرائت خاص خود از فقه دیوبندی، روایتی ساخته‌اند که در آن مخالفت با طالبان معادل مخالفت با «سنت پشتون» جلوه داده می‌شود؛ همان نقطه‌ای که بسیاری از تحلیل‌گران و حتا فعالان پشتون به آن معترض‌ اند. نکته‌ای که اغلب نادیده گرفته می‌شود این است که پشتونوالی در ذات خود نظام مشورتی و افقی است. جرگه بر پایه‌ اجماع بزرگان کار می‌کند، نه فرمان یک امیر. زنان مسن هم در بسیاری از جرگه‌های سنتی صاحب رأی بوده‌اند. مهمان‌نوازی، حتا نسبت به دشمن، اصل مقدس شمرده می‌شود. این تصویر با آنچه امروز از حکمرانی طالبان می‌بینیم -ساختاری متمرکز حول یک «امیرالمؤمنین»، بی‌اعتنا به رأی جمعی و بسته به‌روی دنیای بیرون- فاصله‌ی قابل‌توجهی دارد. بیشتر بخوانید: etilaatroz.com/257805

Allow me to explain the core problem with the #EU #ageVerification concept. They're trying to solve an ontological problem with cryptography; something which is logically & demonstrably impossible. They're conflating a cryptographic, epistemic claim "this credential belongs to someone over 18" with the ontological "this person is over 18". Even perfect Zero-Knowledge Proofs (ZKPs) do not bridge the gap between digital assertions and physical reality. There's not a cryptographic protocol on earth that does. लोकमान्य बाळ गंगाधर टिळक हे स्वातंत्र्यलढ्यातील त्या अग्रणी नायकांपैकी एक होते, ज्यांनी स्वातंत्र्याच्या आंदोलनात तरुणांना संघटित आणि प्रेरित करण्यासोबतच स्वभाषा, स्वदेशी आणि स्वसंस्कृतीसाठी आयुष्यभर संघर्ष केला. "स्वराज्य हा माझा जन्मसिद्ध अधिकार आहे आणि तो मी मिळवणारच!" त्यांच्या या घोषणेने संपूर्ण राष्ट्रामध्ये नवचैतन्य निर्माण केले आणि स्वातंत्र्याची भावना तळागाळातील लोकांपर्यंत पोहोचवली. गणेशोत्सव आणि छत्रपती शिवाजी महाराज जयंती यांसारख्या आयोजनांतून त्यांनी राष्ट्रीय जागृतीचे अभूतपूर्व कार्य केले. त्यांचा 'गीता रहस्य' हा कालजयी ग्रंथ आजही आपल्याला कर्तव्यपथावर ठाम राहण्याची प्रेरणा देतो. लोकसेवा आणि राष्ट्रनिष्ठेचे प्रतीक असलेल्या टिळक महाराजांना त्यांच्या जयंतीनिमित्त कोटी कोटी प्रणाम!

This is something I think prediction market people don't take seriously enough. I've often heard prediction markets called "truth engines", but too often their backers forget that they're not predicting The Thing but a simulacrum of The Thing. A market for temperature was cheated when someone found the actual sensor used to measure the temperature, placed a big bet on HOT, and ran a hair dryer on the sensor to make the it hotter. The market was for the sensor, not the actual weather. There are similar ways to cheat all sorts of markets that aren't being used right now, but will be used if the monetary incentives grow strong enough. Paying trial participants to lie. Paying athletes to change how they play. Paying insiders to insert specific words into speeches. I've been fascinated by the potential of prediction markets for a long time, but I don't think they worry enough about the trust-eroding implications of this kind of thing happening at scale. It takes a thousand years to build three centimetres of topsoil. We lose a football pitch of it every five seconds. A third of the world's farmable soil is already dead. The UN warned that if the stripping goes on, we have sixty harvests left. Iowa, the richest ground in America, has lost close to half its topsoil since 1850. Ploughed loose and sent down the Mississippi. Warming gets the summits and the placards. The soil that grows ninety-five percent of your food is washing away right now, and that is the one that starves you. Here is the part that stays off the stage. The deepest, blackest, most fertile ground on earth, the American prairie, the Russian steppe, the Ukrainian black earth that feeds the world, was built by one thing. Vast herds of grazing ruminants. Trampling, dunging, moving on. Tens of millions of bison, roots fifteen feet deep, packing carbon into the ground for ten thousand years. The plough switched that off. The cow, moved like the wild herd, switches it back on. Graze it right and the carbon sinks, the soil thickens, the rain soaks in instead of tearing the field away. The best machine ever built for saving the soil is the animal they want off your plate. A tractor cannot build soil. Fertiliser cannot build soil. Only the herd ever has. But healing the world's dirt means more cattle on grass, not fewer. So you will hear about the cow's burp right up until the last of the topsoil reaches the sea.

بعید است که طالبان ندانند که آدم‌های نرمال -با هوش معمولی- به افغانستان تحت حاکمیت طالبان پناهنده نخواهند شد. این نیز بعید است که طالبان گمان کنند افغانستان در آینده‌ای نزدیک مقصد پناه‌جویان عادی از ممالک دیگر شود. پس چرا قانونی برای پناهندگی می‌سازند؟ پاسخ این سوال تقریبا روشن است: هر کشوری، با هر وضعیتی، حق دارد پناهنده بپذیرد و قانونی در این زمینه داشته باشد. طالبان از همین امکان استفاده می‌کنند تا راه را برای ورود صدها و هزاران افراطی مسلمان از کشورهای دیگر (که بتوانند بازوی نظامی طالبان شوند) هموار کنند. درست است که افراد عادی‌ای که در پی زندگی بهتری هستند، به افغانستان پناهنده نخواهند شد. اما تروریستان و افراطیانی که یا به خاطر ایمان ایدئولوژیک خود به طالبانیسم یا به دلیل جا نداشتن در هیچ کشور دیگری دنبال یک «پناه» هستند، قطعا افغانستان را جای مناسبی برای پناهندگی خواهند دانست. این افراد در پی آزادی و امنیت و رفاه و تحصیل و زندگی بهتر نیستند؛ دنبال مکانی هستند که به خشونت، ترور، بی‌قانونی، زورگویی و افراطی‌گری مجال واسعی بدهند. افغانستان امروز چنان مکانی است. وقتی قانون پناهندگی مذکور اجرا شود (مطابق اصول شرعی و اسلامی)، همه‌ی تروریستان وابسته به سازمان‌هایی چون تحریک طالبان پاکستان و گروه‌های افراطی دیگر منطقه و جهان در افغانستان وضعیت «پناهنده» خواهند یافت. قدم بعدی، اعطای قانونی شهروندی به این «پناهندگان» و خانواده‌های‌شان است و انتقال آنان به مناطقی از افغانستان که قرار است با ترکیب جمعیتی جدیدی تنظیم شوند. کاملا روشن است که طرح چنین قانونی (در حالی که خود افغانستان هنوز قانون اساسی ندارد) یک طرح عملیاتی برای تنظیم رابطه‌ی طالبان با افراد و گروه‌های افراطی منطقه -مخصوصا گروه‌های تروریستی فعال در خاک پاکستان- است. وگرنه، چنان که گفته شد، خود شهروندان افغانستان شب‌وروز در پی خروج از افغانستان طالبانی هستند. بیشتر بخوانید: etilaatroz.com/257799

Propusemos a mesa, fui pessoalmente aos EUA, e nossos ministros fizeram várias tentativas de dialogar. Mesmo não encontrando reciprocidade na conversa, seguimos e seguiremos negociando. Seguiremos, também, ampliando nossas parcerias. Buscando novos mercados. E dialogando com todo mundo que desejar negociar com o Brasil. The Iran war increased the political urgency for this deal The Iran war is reshaping the balance of power in the Middle East in ways that will only become clear months and years from now. As I argued at the outset of the war, Saudi Arabia has long sought to become the dominant power in the Middle East, and Iran has consistently posed the greatest threat to this goal. The war has emboldened Tehran and threatened the Gulf in ways that are deeply counterproductive to this goal, but Saudi Arabia is intent on leveraging this dynamic moment to assert its regional leadership. The new Saudi-US nuclear deal this week, along with renewed confrontation between Riyadh and the Houthis and the shifting Saudi–United Arab Emirates rift, are all connected to this effort. By keeping the door open for uranium enrichment inside Saudi Arabia, the nuclear deal sends a powerful message to Tehran. By securing a 123 agreement that appears to have more preferable terms than the United Arab Emirates and dozens of other US partners have committed to, Riyadh also signals its role as a major global player, even if it is not among the ranks of nuclear-armed nations. The nuclear deal has been in the works for months, long before the Iran war, and initial negotiations on the deal began even earlier, as part of a larger package that included Israeli normalization. But it is possible that the Iran war lent greater political urgency to the negotiations, as Washington has sought to reassure a partner that is increasingly wary of US security commitments and frustrated by the lack of consultation. And we should read the announcement as part of Riyadh’s broader strategy to managing the shockwaves of the Iran war. — Allison Minor is the director of the Project for Middle East Integration with the Atlantic Council’s Rafik Hariri Center and @ACMideast programs. She previously served as US deputy special envoy for Yemen and as director for Arabian Peninsula affairs at the National Security Council.

It would be a mistake to allow Saudi Arabia the capability for enrichment Washington is right to strengthen its relationship with Riyadh, but it should not do so at the expense of its effective nuclear weapons nonproliferation standards. Since the dawn of the nuclear age, scientists have understood that uranium enrichment and plutonium reprocessing are dual-use technologies. The same technology used to make fuel for nuclear reactors can make fuel for nuclear weapons. Accordingly, Washington’s strategy has been to encourage peaceful uses of nuclear technology, while restricting sensitive fuel-making technology. My first book, Exporting the Bomb: Technology Transfer and the Spread of Nuclear Weapons, examined this topic. Washington’s policy has been successful and imposed on friends and enemies alike. The Pentagon, for example, used military force to stop Iran’s enrichment program both this year and in 2025. And, over the years, the United States has used its influence to forestall the spread of sensitive fuel-making capabilities to allies and partners, including South Korea, Taiwan, and the United Arab Emirates. It would be a mistake, therefore, to allow enrichment in Saudi Arabia as part of any deal. Fortunately, a Saudi enrichment program is not guaranteed. It is reported that the parties will “carry out a two-year study to examine the value of enrichment for Saudi Arabia, including whether it would be commercially viable to enrich uranium on Saudi soil instead of relying on imported fuel.” This study should conclude that Saudi Arabia can rely on imported fuel-cycle services like the many other countries around the world with truly peaceful nuclear programs. This would be a much better outcome than exporting a bomb-making capability to an additional country in an already volatile region. — @MatthewKroenig is a nonresident senior fellow with the Atlantic Council’s @ACScowcroft Center for Strategy and Security. He previously served as vice president for geostrategy and fellows and senior director of the Atlantic Council’s Scowcroft Center for Strategy and Security.

I received a phone call today by someone claiming to be from the military, the person sent me my excise sheet and footage from the motorway toll plaza of my vehicle entering the highway. He claimed that I had passed his vehcile while over speeding and that he had barely survived the crash after I had sped away. He demanded a compensation of 1.2 million. The only fact is that the date he mentioned I was out of the country. I told him to share his particulars, he then named a senior military official, claiming to be his nephew. And that he would have me picked up. Regardless that this was scam to extort money, I understand that it’s not difficult to get details of vehicles or assets, but how come he managed to retrieve the camera footage from a motorway toll plaza, which is basically surveillance footage controlled by the government. Is the system that compromised that our data is so easily available to anyone who can buy it? Are criminals now operating in tandem with networks deep within our surveillance system? Is there any accountability at any level?

हीरो राहुल गांधी नही हैं। दीपके या सोनम नही हैं। हीरो वे बच्चे है जो सीना ताने, लाठियां खा रहे हैं। वे लोग है, जो जोमैटो स्विगी पर खाना, पानी, दवाएं भेज रहे हैं। हीरो वे उम्रदराज अंकल, आंटी है, जिनके शायद अपने बच्चे पेपर लीक से प्रभावित नहीं। मगर वे बाहें फैलाये, घायल बच्चों को सहला रहे हैं। ●● हीरो वे है, जो इस ब्रूटलिटी की तस्वीरे देखने के बावजूद अगली सुबह, प्रोटेस्ट साइट पर पहुँच रहे हैं। हीरो वे है जो छोटे छोटे यू ट्यूब चैनल बनाकर, मौके की असली कहानी हम तक भेज रहे हैं। हीरो वे पुलिस वाले भी है, जो मजबूरन लाठी उठाते हैं, मगर उसका प्रहार जितना हल्का हो सके उतना रखते हैं। तो अपनी बात, अपनी सराहना, अपना आशीर्वाद उनकी ओर रखे.. जो इस संग्राम में असली हीरो हैं। ●● और बचे राहुल गांधी, या दीगर नेता। तो आईटी सेल की स्टाइल में शेर की तरह चलते, सिंघम के म्यूजिक या स्लो मोशन की फिल्मी स्टाइल में डालने के लिए उम्र पड़ी है यारों। कर लेना। क्योकि उनको सहयोग, सपोर्ट देने का मौका तो रोज रहेगा। पर आज सहारा, हिम्मत उन्हें दें, जो अपनी ऊर्जा और लहू, जंतर मंतर की बैरिकेटिंग पर बिखरा रहे हैं। उन्हें इसकी सख्त जरूरत है। प्लीज!!

Received a progress brief on the Kenya Home of Human Origins Museum and Science Park project that is set to be established in the Lake Turkana Basin. Spearheaded by a presidential taskforce and the National Museums of Kenya, the project aims at transforming the region into a global centre for research, preservation of heritage and eco-tourism. Planned for Kalokol area, a central place between Turkana and Marsabit counties, the project will help in the repatriation of 32,000 Kenyan heritage collections across the world. At the local level, the community will benefit from the provision of water for people and livestock, boosting of security, digital connectivity, development of infrastructure, improvement of health and educational facilities, and renovation of existing museums, among others. Turkana region has been at the centre of groundbreaking archeological discoveries over the years, including the 1.6 million years old Turkana Boy and the oldest stone tools used by the Early Man.

Israel is closely monitoring Iran's continued missile fire, not only toward Gulf states but also near Israel, with launches reaching the Aqaba area, as well as President Trump's threats to escalate U.S. strikes. PM Netanyahu is expected to convene the Security Cabinet on Sunday to discuss Israel's next steps. According to Israeli security officials, Israel would consider joining the campaign against Iran only if two conditions are met: 1. Iran directly attacks Israel. 2. Current assessments in Jerusalem do not point to an imminent change in the situation, though officials acknowledge growing internal pressure inside Iran to escalate the conflict.
